summary.en: The sheet on top turns away over its top or left edge, darkening as it tilts, onto the page that lay underneath.
summary.zh: 最上面那张纸绕上边或左边翻走，越翻越暗，露出压在下面的那页。

fits: A page change between two exhibits of one file.
notFor: Frame-level cuts; sheets that should stay in view.

intent.en: The next evidence was under this one all along: the change is paper being handled, not a cut.
intent.zh: 下一份证据一直压在这份下面：换页是翻纸，不是剪辑。

content.en: Two exhibits (specs as the scenes take them).
content.zh: 两份证物（与场景同样的参数）。

fits.zh: 同一卷宗里两份证物之间的换页。

notFor.zh: 整帧切换；需要留在画面里的纸。

en: The page underneath is still and whole from the first frame; only the top sheet moves.
zh: 下面那页从第一帧起就完整、静止；只有上面那张在动。

overlaps.note: runtime: a device turned about its centre in 3D; here a paper sheet hinged on an edge, drawn in perspective strips

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)

endsMoving.reason: the template's turn ends edge-on at its fastest on the downbeat; the page underneath (or the next cut) takes over on that frame
